column196: description_Bangladesh: 64 displacements (destroyed housing), 02 August - 02 August. Erosion resulted in more than or equal to 15 households being displaced due to destroyed housing in Kaliganj on 2 August, according to government.
column197: description_Bangladesh: 8,400,000 displacements, 26 May - 27 May. According to UN Country Team, approximately 8400000 people were displaced in Barguna District, Barisal District, Bhola District, Jhalokathi District, Patuakhali District, Pirojpur District, Bagerhat Sadar Subdistrict, Narail District, Khulna Division, Satkhira due to Cyclone Remal on 26 May
column198: description_Bangladesh: 808,510 displacements (evacuated), 26 May - 29 May. According to IFRC, more than 800,000 people were evacuated in multiple districts in Khulna Division due to Cyclone Remal between 26-29 May.
